messages:
Maya (People Ops): Heads-up: we rolled a clarifying update to the employee handbook this morning on parental/caregiver leave coordination with short-term disability and intermittent leave. Please skim and ack if you oversee manager approvals. Link: https://docs.redwoodinc.com/people/handbook/caregiver-leave :page_facing_up:

Maya (People Ops): We're also launching a 10-min microlearning module for managers + manager-facing ICs. Completion required by Apr 12. Tracker + LMS link below.

Maya (People Ops): Tracker instructions: 1) list your teams in Col B, 2) add manager ack in Col D, 3) paste LMS export into the "LMS Import" tab. Tracker: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1Xxx-TrackerLink

Eli (Recruiting): Quick Q  do new hires in onboarding need to complete this immediately, or can we include it in the 30-day onboarding checklist?

Jules (HR Support): Include in the 30-day checklist for new hires. For hiring managers, completion is required within the first 14 days of a new manager's start date.

Sam R (Eng Manager): Do contractors fall into this? We have some long-term vendors who are manager-facing.

Jules (HR Support): Mandatory for W2 employees and any contractors who make people decisions. We'll add a contractor flag column in the tracker and a note for vendor-managed staff. If a vendor contract prohibits training, escalate to people-ops.

Lina (Legal): Reviewed the handbook wording. Two tiny edits suggested (examples for "eligible caregiver" and clarifying the 30-day admin window). Also: EU region needs 3-year retention of acknowledgements.

Maya (People Ops): Thanks Lina  I added an "EU" column and accepted the examples. We'll snapshot the handbook after legal signs off and send a policy email tomorrow.

HR-bot: Reminder scheduled  automated manager reminders will go out Apr 5 for unconfirmed teams.

Sam R (Eng Manager): Can the manager ack be an emoji in the sheet? I can only spare a quick click per team. :sweat_smile:

Maya (People Ops): Emoji is fine for initial ack. For audits we need a timestamped confirmation row; people-ops will populate timestamps when reconciling completions.

Eli (Recruiting): Also, when we hire into EU, should recruiting mark the hire as EU in the tracker, or will people-ops do that?

Jules (HR Support): Recruiting should mark hires as EU during requisition close. We'll verify during reconciliation.

Maya (People Ops): Optional drop-in Q&A sessions next week: Tue 11am PT and Thu 4pm PT. RSVP in Col G on the tracker.

Sam R (Eng Manager): I'll RSVP for Tue.

Maya (People Ops): Action items: managers confirm teams in Col B by Mar 30; managers + manager-facing ICs complete module by Apr 12; people-ops to export LMS completions Apr 13 and reconcile.

Lina (Legal): One more reminder: do not post medical or sensitive health info in Slack. Use the secure form linked on the handbook page for intake.

Maya (People Ops): Agreed  added a bold reminder on the handbook page. Thanks all. :heart:
